one_liner: Gumroad has a free, self-serve REST v2 API with OAuth2 app registration and personal access tokens, plus an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Authorization-code OAuth (gumroad.com/oauth/authorize, token at api.gumroad.com/oauth/token) with scopes; apps registered self-serve in Settings > Advanced. A manually generated access token works for one's own account.
access_notes: Any Gumroad account can create an application and generate a token in advanced settings; no plans or review queue (per third-party guide and Gumroad help article).
blocker_notes: None found. No sandbox; test with a throwaway account.

evidence.quote: To create an application for general use, you'll need to build a [Redirect URI](https://www.oauth.com/oauth2-servers/redirect-uris/) handler to generate access tokens for each of your users.
Use the "Generate access token" button to get your access token.
no tier gates API access and any account can create an application and issue itself a token.
